title: Harden the order id and promo-code parsing on checkout
description: Tightens the order id validator used by the checkout route and adds a helper that turns a promo code into the discount it applies.

expected.note: `id == parsed` uses loose equality, so a string that merely coerces to the parsed number is accepted: "1.0", "01" and " 1" all pass even though they are not valid integer ids. Use `===` (or keep the `Number.isInteger` check) so only an exact integer string is allowed.

The code is split on "-" and whatever follows is coerced to a number without validation, so a malformed code ("SAVE", "SAVE-ABC") yields `NaN` and is returned as a discount. Validate the format and reject non-numeric or out-of-range percentages.
